description: This file contains functions and type definitions for probing and retrieving server info from the BlueBubbles API, including caching mechanisms, version parsing, and connectivity checks.

methods.name: buildCacheKey
methods.description: Creates a cache key string based on the account ID, trimming whitespace or defaulting to 'default'.

methods.name: fetchBlueBubblesServerInfo
methods.description: Fetches server info from the BlueBubbles API and caches the result, returning null on failure.

methods.name: getCachedBlueBubblesServerInfo
methods.description: Returns cached server info if available and not expired.

methods.name: getCachedBlueBubblesPrivateApiStatus
methods.description: Returns the cached private API status for a given account ID, or null if unknown.

methods.name: isBlueBubblesPrivateApiStatusEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the private API status is enabled (true).

methods.name: isBlueBubblesPrivateApiEnabled
methods.description: Determines if the private API is enabled for a given account ID based on cached info.

methods.name: parseMacOSMajorVersion
methods.description: Parses a macOS version string to extract the major version number.

methods.name: isMacOS26OrHigher
methods.description: Checks if the cached server info indicates macOS version 26 or higher.

methods.name: clearServerInfoCache
methods.description: Clears the server info cache, typically for testing.

methods.name: probeBlueBubbles
methods.description: Probes the BlueBubbles server to check connectivity and responsiveness.
